summary: Iteration 10: verified (1) NEW admin_korpri login pardz2006@gmail.com/korpri123, (2) landing page catalog filter behavior, (3) full booking->pay->SPR->KPR bank isolation flow with REAL data. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_full_flow.py — 7/7 pytest tests PASSED. Drove consumer@ to create 2 bookings (Griya KORPRI Harmoni [Bank BTN, FLPP] + Bumi ASN Residence [Bank DKI, KOMERSIAL]), initiated payment via POST /api/bookings/{id}/pay, simulated webhook POST /api/payments/webhook with kind=booking_fee -> payment_status=paid + spr_status=draft, then developer@ (owner of both projects) POST /api/bookings/{id}/spr/approve issuing SPR and auto-creating KPR applications with project.bank field. Result: btn@ GET /api/kpr/applications returns ONLY the Bank BTN application; bankdki@ returns ONLY the Bank DKI one. Cross-bank PATCH (btn@ patching the DKI app) => 403 as expected; same-bank PATCH => 200 and status persisted to pre_approved. Developer scoping regression holds (dev1 still sees exactly {Griya KORPRI Harmoni, Bumi ASN Residence}). Frontend: catalog-filter loads with 6 project cards + live count 'Menampilkan 6 dari 6 proyek'; Program=Komersial -> 3 cards; City=Bekasi -> 2 cards; Type=36 -> 3 cards; Price>1M -> 2 cards; filter-reset restores 6; FLPP + >1M yields 0 cards AND data-testid=filter-empty is shown; Bekasi+Komersial combo -> 1 card. Admin login pardz2006 through UI succeeds, toast 'Berhasil masuk' displayed, redirected to /crm showing 'Dashboard CRM Rumah KORPRI' with Total Pemesanan=2, Pembayaran Lunas=2, SPR Terbit=2 (matching the 2 real bookings I just drove through). NOTE: Radix Select option label for FLPP is 'FLPP (Subsidi)' not plain 'FLPP' — test scripts must use the full label.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1105 lines — carry-over recommendation to split by resource routers.
Note for future authors: Radix Select option label for FLPP program is 'FLPP (Subsidi)'; test scripts should match by exact label including the parenthetical suffix.

approve_spr assigns kpr application bank from project.bank with fallback to 'Bank BTN' — safe because seed guarantees bank; but if a project were ever seeded without a bank field, KOMERSIAL bookings could silently be routed to BTN. Consider raising 500 or defaulting based on program.
